intentions: We need the privileged-operation audit system completed before the January release.

QA: Test access for administrator, manager and regular employee roles and verify that denied actions generate audit events.
technical_context: Audit records must remain available for at least 180 days.
Use existing PostgreSQL database and FastAPI service.
Authentication layer provides user IDs and role information.
